t: She fell ten kilometers out of the sky, without a parachute. And lived.
Nineteen seventy-two. Flight attendant Vesna Vulović wasn't even meant to work this flight. They'd mixed her up with another Vesna.
Over Czechoslovakia, a bomb goes off in the luggage hold.
The plane breaks apart. Everyone else dies. Vesna is pinned inside the wreck by a food cart.
It hits a snowy, wooded mountainside, at just the right angle.
A villager, once a wartime medic, finds her alive.
Fractured skull. Both legs broken. Three broken vertebrae. Paralyzed from the waist down.
Doctors think low blood pressure saved her: she blacked out instantly, so her heart didn't burst.
Ten months later, she walks again. She remembers nothing, so she isn't even afraid to fly.
It's still the Guinness record: the highest fall ever survived without a parachute.
Would you fly again? Tell me in the comments.
